title: One-cover refinement of a pointed inverse system
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $(J,\geq,V_j,g_{jj'})$ be a directed inverse system of objects of $\mathcal C$: $J$ is a nonempty directed poset, each $j\geq j'$ has a transition $g_{jj'}:V_j\to V_{j'}$, and $g_{jj}=\mathrm{id}$, $g_{j'j''}g_{jj'}=g_{jj''}$. Put $u'(W)=\varinjlim_{j\in J}\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(V_j,W)$ and $\mathcal F_{p'}=\varinjlim_{j\in J}\mathcal F(V_j)$ for a sheaf of sets $\mathcal F$ on $\mathcal C$ (filtered colimits of sets [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]). Let $s\ne s'$ in $\mathcal F_{p'}$, let $\{W_k\to W\}_{k\in K}$ be a covering of $\mathcal C$ with $K$ finite, and let $f\in u'(W)$. Then there is a directed inverse system $(I,\geq,U_i,f_{ii'})$ of objects of $\mathcal C$ refining the given one, i.e. $J\subset I$, the order of $J$ is the one induced from $I$, $U_j=V_j$ and $f_{jj'}=g_{jj'}$ for $j\geq j'$ in $J$, such that the images of $s,s'$ under the canonical map $\mathcal F_{p'}\to\varinjlim_{i\in I}\mathcal F(U_i)$ remain distinct and the image of $f$ under the canonical map $u'(W)\to u(W)=\varinjlim_{i\in I}\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(U_i,W)$ lies in the image of $u(W_k)\to u(W)$ (composition with $W_k\to W$) for some $k\in K$.
